name: Mohamed Lamine Debaghine University of Setif 2
Australian National University
description:
Founded in 1946, the Australian National University (ANU) supports a community of over 25,500 students. The ANU campus is located in Canberra, the capital of Australia and comprises seven academic colleges, which host a number of schools and research centres specialising in a variety of disciplines. The university is especially renowned for the strength of its Arts and Humanities and Natural Sciences departments. ANU courses are taught in small classes and state-of-the-art collaborative spaces that stimulate students to think differently. As ANU students, incoming exchange participants will have the support of our vibrant and talented community including access to academic, sporting, cultural and social activities, and access to comprehensive wellbeing support.
ANU is located in the heart of Canberra, our beautiful and vibrant capital city. Canberra’s accessibility, friendliness, and overall quality of life makes it the perfect place to live, study and explore the region.
Get a glimpse of a day in the life of an ANU exchange student!

name: Deakin University
description:
The university was founded in 1974 and supports a community of 60,000 students from 120 countries. As an internationally recognised university for 50+ years, we’ve supported over 300,000 students on their journeys to great things. Our passion and commitment to teaching, research and student success is recognised by local and international ranking bodies, as well as our students, placing us in the top 200 universities globally.
Deakin has four campuses: Melbourne Burwood in the city of Melbourne, Geelong Waurn Punds and Geeling Waterfront approximately 1 hour from the city and Warrnambool three hours from Melbourne. From sport, health and personal development to religious, political and course-specific groups, there's more than 120 clubs and societies across the campuses.
Hear more about what studying at Deakin University is like, directly from the
International Student Ambassador Program
!

name: Griffith University
description:
Since 1975, our teaching and research have been shaped by a commitment to social justice, environmental sustainability and inclusive access to education. Today, those ideals are more important than ever. As we enter the second half of Griffith’s first century as a globally recognised university of excellence, we’re building on this legacy by placing purpose, people, partnerships and communities squarely at the centre of what we do.
From pioneering research and student entrepreneurship to supporting Indigenous flourishing and expanding access to education through online learning, we’re continuously adding to our history of making a difference in the world around us. With more than 40,000 students, our community spans five campuses across South East Queensland plus our Digital campus. We’re also proud to be home to a global alumni network of over 200,000 graduates.
See what it is like studying at Griffith University!

name: Macquarie University
description:
Macquarie University is recognised globally for its pre-eminence in key research disciplines, as well as producing graduates who are among the most sought-after professionals in the world.
Since our foundation in 1964, we have aspired to be a different type of university: one unbound by ivory towers and sandstone walls. Rather, we are focused on fostering collaboration between students, academics, industry and society, encouraging all to traverse the boundaries of their own perspectives and effect change.
The campus is located in the heart of Australia’s largest high-tech precinct, only 18 minutes from downtown Sydney. Like a miniature city, Macquarie has a vast array of amenities on campus including a bookshop, a bar and several cafés.
Take a tour of Macquarie University

name: Monash University
description:
The university was founded in 1958 and has now grown into an ecosystem of campuses, educations centers and partnerships spanning the globe. With approximately 87,000 students from over 170 countries, Monash is now Australia's largest university and ranked in the world’s top 1%.
The university operates four campuses across Melbourne: Clayton campus (approximately 30 minutes from downtown Melbourne), Caulfield campus (about 12 kilometers from the city), Parkville campus (a short tram ride north of Melbourne) and Peninsula campus (in the suburb of Frankston).
Learn more about Monash University!

name: Queensland University of Technology
description:
The university was founded in 1989 and supports a community of over 52,000 students, including around 8,000 from overseas. Queensland University of Technology (QUT) is a major Australian university with a truly global outlook. We’re providing real-world infrastructure, learning and teaching, and graduate skills to the next generation of change-makers.
Brisbane is the fastest growing city in Australia and the host of the 2032 Olympics. Our friendly, modern city averages 240 sunny days per year and is the gateway to the stunning and diverse state of Queensland.The QUT International Student Services team organize short trips and weekend activities for international students, so you can see Australia and make friends with international students.
See what life is like as an international student at QUT

name: University of Adelaide
description:
Established in 1874, the University of Adelaide is Australia's third oldest university. Adelaide has over 27,000 registered students, around 9,000 of whom are international. By every measure, the University of Adelaide—a member of Australia’s prestigious Group of Eight research-intensive universities—stands tall among the world’s leading institutions of learning and innovation.
Considered one of the top 1% of Universities worldwide, we count among our distinguished alumni: five Nobel Laureates; over 100 Rhodes Scholars, including Australia’s first Indigenous recipient; and Australia’s first female prime minister and Supreme Court judge.
We occupy a unique position among Australian cities, Adelaide is friendly and offers a real sense of community. Its size and sense of comfort means it provides an atmosphere conducive to study. You want beaches? Festivals? Proximity to beautiful Australian nature and the Outback?
Adelaide has all of this - and more!

name: University of Melbourne
description:
Established in 1853, the University of Melbourne is Australia's second oldest university. The University of Melbourne is a public-spirited institution that makes distinctive contributions to society in research, teaching and learning, and engagement. It is consistently ranked among the leading universities in the world, with international rankings of world universities placing it as number 1 in Australia and number 37 in the world (Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2024). Melbourne offers broad undergraduate degrees and world-leading graduate programs to about 54,000 students each year, 44% being international students from 150+ countries.
Campus is located in the heart of Melbourne and there are currently over 200 clubs affiliated to the University of Melbourne Student Union (UMSU). Consistently voted as one of the world’s most livable cities, Melbourne is the cultural and sporting capital of Australia with many festivals and sporting events held throughout the year. With 38% of the population born overseas and 140 cultures represented, Melbourne is extremely multi-cultural and welcoming of people from all backgrounds. Melbourne’s food scene is world class and boasts more coffee shops per capita than any other city in the world!
Check out Melbourne Global Instagram Account

name: University of New South Wales
description:
The university was established in 1949 and supports a community of more than 59,000 students, around 15,000 being international students from 120+ countries. UNSW Sydney is a globally recognised university, ranked among the top 20 worldwide and a leader in research, innovation, and teaching excellence. With over 63,000 students and a vibrant exchange program, UNSW offers a dynamic academic experience enriched by strong industry connections and a global outlook. The university is committed to shaping forward thinking, environmentally conscious and socially engaged students who will make a positive impact in the world.
The main UNSW campus is located at Kensington, seven kilometers from the center of Sydney. UNSW Student Life (Arc) offers 3000 clubs to get social, get active and make the most of the time at UNSW. UNSW also has the Aussie Mate Program, where students can join the planned social activities throughout the semester and meet other exchange- and UNSW students.
Experience our beautiful campus and see your future at UNSW Sydney

name: University of Queensland
description:
The university was founded in 1909 and is the largest university in Queensland with more than 55,000+ students. Over 21,500 being international students from 142 countries. Consistently ranked among the world's top universities. The University of Queensland (UQ) offers award-winning teaching, world-class indoor and outdoor learning environments, and outstanding facilities.
UQ offers more than 220 clubs and societies spread across the three campuses: the
St Lucia campus
, the
Herston campus
, and the
Dutton Park campus
. UQ staff and students can use a free intercampus bus service that runs between St Lucia and Gatton campuses. Home to 5 of Australia's 11 World Heritage destinations and boasting warm weather all year round, discover why Queensland is the best choice to study and live.
Explore what it's like living in Queensland!

name: University of Sydney
description:
The University of Sydney is a world-leading institution committed to academic excellence and groundbreaking research. As Australia’s first university, it offers a rich tradition of innovation and intellectual discovery across a broad spectrum of disciplines. Exchange students benefit from access to inspiring teaching, state-of-the-art facilities, and a supportive learning environment designed to help you reach your full potential. With a strong global outlook and vibrant campus life, the University of Sydney fosters connections that extend far beyond the classroom, enriching your academic journey and future career.
Studying in Sydney provides an unparalleled lifestyle experience that complements your academic pursuits. With a student community of over 70,000 individuals, the university offers a diverse and welcoming environment where you can connect with peers from all over the world. Sydney itself is a thriving global city, known for its iconic landmarks, stunning beaches, and vibrant cultural scene. On campus, you’ll find more than 200 student clubs and societies spanning interests from sports and arts to academic and cultural groups, providing endless opportunities to engage, grow, and make lasting friendships. This dynamic blend of city life and campus community ensures your exchange experience will be as enriching personally as it is academically.
Hear about the USyd exchange experience!

name: University of Tasmania
description:
The university was founded in 1846 and supports a community of more than 35,000 students, 7,000 being international students from all over the world. Become an exchange student at the University of Tasmania and take advantage of Tasmania's unique and stunning environment. With 45% of our island State being National Park or World Heritage listed, it is no wonder that some of Tasmania's most breathtaking destinations, including Cradle Mountain and Tasman National Park, feature prominently in the Lonely Planet's 1000 Ultimate Adventures Guide.
Stunning beaches to surf, mountains to climb and rivers to raft, Tasmania the home of the Tassie Devil and the gateway to Antarctica will become your living playground, with the university being the epicentre of your state-sized class room.
With exceptional teaching staff excelling in areas including Zoology, Geography and Environmental studies, Marine and Antarctic science, Law, Aboriginal studies, Journalism and Media, combined with Summer rock concerts, Winter festivals and an art and cafe scene that will 'knock your socks off', the University of Tasmania can offer you an inspirational and diverse study experience, both enriching academically, socially, culturally and environmentally.
University of Tasmania incoming exchange

name: University of Technology Sydney
description:
In 1988, the former New South Wales Institute of Technology, founded in 1964, became the University of Technology Sydney. UTS is one of the largest universities in Australia with a total enrolment of over 45,000+ students. Study in award-winning labs and collaborative classrooms and work with the tools and technologies that are shaping your industry. Each year we welcome more than 1000 study abroad and exchange students from around the world – just like you. With students from 120 different countries, UTS is an exciting place to be!
The main campus, City Campus, is located right next to Central station and Victoria Park.
UTS is part of the Australian Technology Network of universities: a group of five prominent universities committed to working with industry and government to deliver practical and professional courses.
See what it is like studying abroad at the University of Technology Sydney

name: University of Western Australia
description:
Established as the State's first university in 1911 and founded with a mission to "advance the prosperity and welfare of our communiyties," the University opeened in 1913 to just 184 students. Today, more than 28,000 students are enrolled from 115 countries. For more than 100 years, we have contributed to the intellectural, cultural and economic development of Western Australia, the nation and our world.
At UWA, sport plays a central role in the lives of students and promotes a healthy campus culture. Whether you’re training for a gold medal or looking for a spin, dance or Pilates class, UWA Sport offers programs and membership options to suit everyone. Compared to other major cities around the world, Perth is the perfect place to live, work and study. Not only is it one of the most liveable cities in the world (15th in the world to be exact), but it’s also more affordable than Sydney and Melbourne too (Worldwide Cost of Living Report 2023, Economist Intelligence Unit).
University of Western Australia from an international perspective

name: University of Wollongong
description:
The University of Wollongong enjoys an international reputation for world-class research, exceptional teaching quality and graduate outcomes. We are a young and vibrant university with undiminished ambitions. We value our research capacity to work on complex interdisciplinary problems. Our spirit of inquiry drives our research and learning environments and our objective of earning a place in the top 1% of the world’s universities. With 120 clubs and societies, live acts on campus each year, it’s just a matter of choosing between them.
Being Australia’s 9th largest city and just over an hour from Sydney, Wollongong is a vibrant city that offers the perfect Australian lifestyle. It’s affordable, easy to get around and enjoys a lower cost of living than other Australian cities. Situated on the shores of the Pacific Ocean between the mountains and the sea, students can enjoy a relaxed coastal lifestyle with 17 patrolled surf beaches.
Take a virtual campus tour

name: Western Sydney University
description:
The University was founded in 1989 and is one of the largest universities in Australia with 42,000 students. We’re ranked among the top two per cent of universities in the world, with a growing international reputation for research-led, student-centred learning. Unlike the traditional lecturer-down approach, our pioneering model of co-created learning treats our students as partners in their education. We empower students to share ideas and develop their creativity through a range of degrees.
WSU is a multi-site university with campuses spread across Greater Western Sydney, including Bankstown; Blacktown/Nirimba; Campbelltown; Hawkesbury; Parramatta and Penrith. A Shuttle Bus drives from campus to campus making it easy to access all of the WSU facilities. Sydney is one of the most liveable and picturesque global cities. With the world's largest natural harbour, 100km of coastline and beaches to explore, and an abundance of cultural activities year round, it's no wonder that Australia's largest city is consistently ranked internationally as one of the top 12 urban centres to visit or live in.
See why you should choose Western Sydney University

name: Sigmund Freud University Vienna
description:
The Sigmund Freud University (SFU) was founded in 2003 with the aim of transforming psychotherapy into psychotherapy science, based on an academic foundation. The campus is located in Vienna.
Sigmund Freud University pioneered the study of Psychotherapy Science as an academic degree. This program approaches Psychotherapy by emphasizing research activities, practical training, and academic exchange among different psychotherapy schools. Sigmund Freud University is one of the only academic institutions in the world, where Psychotherapy is taught at an undergraduate level.

name: SOP Hilmbauer & Mauberger GmbH & Co KG
TU Wien
description:
For more than 200 years, founded in 1815, TU Wien has been a place of research, teaching and learning in the service of progress.
TU Wien is among the most successful technical universities in Europe and is Austria’s largest scientific-technical research and educational institution. The TU Wien is divided into eight faculties with a total of 52 institutes responsible for teaching as well as research.

name: University of Klagenfurt
description:
Nestled between the Alps and the Adriatic Sea, Alpen-Adria-Universität Klagenfurt is a modern, research-driven university located in one of Austria’s most picturesque regions, Carinthia, near the shores of Lake Wörthersee, not far from the borders of Italy and Slovenia. As the leading academic institution in Carinthia, it offers a vibrant and international study environment with a strong commitment to innovation, sustainability, and interdisciplinary collaboration. Exchange students benefit from a wide range of English-taught courses across faculties such as humanities, technical sciences, management, and social sciences, as well as from personalized support services and a welcoming campus culture. With its dynamic academic offerings and high quality of life, the university provides an ideal setting for a rewarding and enriching exchange semester.
The university has around 1700 staff and 13,000 students. Work and research are carried out at AAU’s four faculties. Since it was founded in the year 1970, the university has become firmly established as the leading institution of academic education in Carinthia, and serves as an important hub for the acquisition, exchange and transfer of knowledge across the entire Alps-Adriatic Region.

name: University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences, Vienna (BOKU)
description:
The University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences (BOKU), is a teaching and research center for renewable resources, which are necessary for human life. It is BOKU's objective to help make a considerable contribution to the conservation and protection of resources for future generations by providing diversity in its fields of study.
The original campus was built in 1896 in the Türkenschanzpark in Vienna's 18th and 19th districts. Some of the departments are still headquartered at this original campus, while other departments are situated at the Mutgasse Campus.

name: University of Salzburg
description:
The University of Salzburg (Paris Lodron University), founded in 1622 and re-established in 1962, is the largest institution of higher education in the province of Salzburg. With approximately 18,000 students and 2,900 staff members across six faculties and 34 departments, it offers a diverse and interdisciplinary academic environment. Exchange students are welcomed into a vibrant international community and can choose from around 90 degree programmes, many of which include English-taught courses. The university’s central location in the historic and culturally rich city of Salzburg—combined with its modern facilities and strong research orientation—makes it an ideal destination for students seeking both academic excellence and an inspiring living experience in the heart of Europe.
Salzburg is one of the safest cities in the world, and the University’s excellent student-to-staff ratio provides students with a supportive environment and a wonderful learning culture. The University’s twenty sites are located in and around Salzburg’s historical center, which is a UNESCO listed world heritage site. Situated in the heart of Europe, Salzburg offers fantastic connections to neighbouring countries and to some of Austria’s most beautiful alpine national parks. It is also a culturally vibrant city, home to world-famous performing arts and music festivals. Operating in this setting, the University of Salzburg offers international students and scholars abroad a unique range of experiences.

name: University of Vienna
description:
Founded in 1365, the University of Vienna is one of Europe’s oldest and most prestigious institutions of higher learning. Today, it hosts approximately 85,000 students, including nearly 30,000 international students from over 120 countries. With 15 faculties and 5 centres, the university offers an exceptionally broad academic portfolio, encompassing 187 degree programmes across disciplines such as humanities, natural sciences, social sciences, law, and economics. Renowned for its cutting-edge research, the university has received over 140 ERC grants and proudly counts Nobel laureates among its faculty. Exchange students benefit from a wide selection of English-taught courses, modern facilities, and a vibrant academic community committed to innovation and global engagement.
Located in the heart of Austria’s capital, the University of Vienna offers students the opportunity to live and study in one of the world’s most liveable cities. Vienna is a cultural and intellectual hub, known for its rich history, classical music heritage, and dynamic arts scene. With over 2 million residents and a strong international presence, the city combines historical charm with modern infrastructure, excellent public transport, and a high quality of life. Students can enjoy everything from world-class museums and concert halls to green parks and cafés, all within walking distance of the university’s central campus. For those seeking both academic enrichment and cultural exploration, Vienna provides an ideal setting for a memorable and rewarding exchange experience.

name: Ghent University
description: The Ghent University was founded by royal decree and opened its doors in 1817. The faculty provides academic teaching and services based on innovative scientific research. The education within these programmes is supported by the innovative scientific research performed within the three faculty departments for interdisciplinary study of law, private law and business law.

name: BRUSSELS FREE UNIVERSITY (ULB)
description:
Université Libre de Bruxelles was founded in 1834 and offers education in all disciplines at all levels. It has 11 faculties and 30,000 students where around 30% are foreign students.
‘The Université libre de Bruxelles bases its teachings and research on the principle of free inquiry. This means that in all matters, independent judgement prevails over arguments of authority.’ Therefore, our University’s academic staff will develop your critical thinking skills and train you to engage in freethinking.
Université Libre de Bruxelles is a French-speaking university and most of the courses are held in French.

name: University of Antwerp
description:
The University of Antwerp (Dutch: Universiteit Antwerpen) is a major Belgian university located in the city of Antwerp. It was founded in 2003 after the merger of three smaller universities. The University of Antwerp has about 20,000 students, which makes it the third largest university in Flanders.
The six campuses are located all over the city of Antwerp, from the historic city center to the green belt to the south of the city.
The language of instruction in Flanders is Dutch. Hence the university offers courses in Dutch, but all faculties also offer courses in English.

name: University of Leuven
description:
KU Leuven is one of Europe’s leading research universities, consistently ranked among the top institutions worldwide for innovation and academic excellence. Founded in 1425, it is the oldest university in Belgium and currently hosts over 64,000 students, including more than 15,000 international students from over 140 countries. With 15 faculties offering nearly 230 degree programmes, KU Leuven provides a comprehensive and interdisciplinary academic environment. The university is renowned for its cutting-edge research, with over 10,000 peer-reviewed publications annually and 168 ERC grants awarded since 2007. Exchange students benefit from a wide selection of English-taught courses, strong academic support, and access to world-class facilities across its campuses.
Located in the historic city of Leuven, just 25 km east of Brussels, KU Leuven offers students a unique blend of academic tradition and modern urban life. Leuven is a vibrant university town with a youthful atmosphere, shaped by its large student population and rich cultural heritage. The city is known for its medieval architecture, lively cafés, and green spaces, making it both welcoming and walkable. Its central location in Europe provides excellent connectivity to major cities such as Brussels, Amsterdam, Paris, and Cologne. For students seeking a stimulating academic experience in a dynamic and international setting, KU Leuven and the city of Leuven together offer an ideal destination for an enriching exchange semester.

name: University of Liège
description:
The University of Liège (ULiège) is a public research university and the only comprehensive institution in French-speaking Belgium offering a full range of academic disciplines. It hosts over 25,000 students and employs more than 3,000 staff members across 11 faculties and several research centres. ULiège is known for its strong commitment to open science, interdisciplinary collaboration, and civic engagement. Its structure encourages cross-faculty cooperation and supports research that addresses complex societal challenges. The university also places emphasis on internationalisation, welcoming students and researchers from over 120 countries and maintaining active partnerships across Europe and beyond.
The university’s main campus is located in Sart Tilman, a green and spacious area just outside the city of Liège, while other facilities are integrated into the urban centre. Liège is a mid-sized city in eastern Belgium, close to the borders of Germany and the Netherlands, offering easy access to major European cities like Brussels, Paris, and Cologne. Known for its industrial heritage and cultural diversity, Liège has a long history of migration and international exchange, making it a relevant and engaging setting for students interested in global and societal issues. The city combines accessible public transport, a lively cultural scene, and a student-friendly atmosphere, providing a balanced environment for both academic focus and everyday life.

name: University of Mons
description:
The University of Mons (UMONS) is a public university located in the Walloon region of Belgium, close to the border with France. It hosts approximately 10,000 students, 25% of them international students, and employs over 1,000 academic and administrative staff. The university is organized into seven faculties and several research institutes, covering a broad range of disciplines. Its relatively small size allows for close interaction between students and faculty, fostering a collaborative academic environment. The university also places emphasis on multilingual education and cross-border cooperation, especially with institutions in neighbouring France.
Mons, the city where UMONS is located, is a regional capital with a rich historical background and a growing cultural profile. It is known for its UNESCO-listed belfry, annual festivals, and role as European Capital of Culture in 2015. The city offers a manageable scale and a student-friendly atmosphere, with affordable living costs and accessible public transport. Mons is situated near the French border and is well connected to Brussels and other major European cities, making it a practical base for exploring Belgium and beyond. For students interested in studying in a bilingual and internationally engaged setting, the University of Mons offers a balanced combination of academic focus and regional accessibility.

name: Fundação Getulio Vargas
description: The FGV Direito Rio (Fundação Getúlio Vargas Rio de Janeiro Law School) is a Brazilian private law School for higher education founded in 2002 in Rio de Janeiro by the Fundação Getúlio Vargas.

name: Pontifical Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro
description:
Pontifical Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio) is a private non-profit Catholic university created in 1941. PUC-Rio is a research institution that focuses primarily on the development of science and innovation.
PUC-RIO is located in Gávea, a charming neighbourhood near the forest and beaches of the Zona Sul area of Rio de Janeiro. The university campus is situated within a tropical forest, surrounded by lush trees and with a small stream running through it.
PUC-Rio has more than 12,000 undergraduate students, 2,500 grdauate students and 1,500 faculty members and researchers, and 26 departments organised in four academic centres: Theology and Human Sciences; Social Sciences; Science and Technology; and Biomedical Sciences.

name: Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro
description:
The Federal University of Rio de Janeiro – UFRJ has three campi: Cidade
Universitária, Praia Vermellha and Macaé, comprising institutes, schools,
faculties and supplementary units, which include seven museums, among
which we can highlight the National Museum, eight university hospitals,
and the third largest ocean basin in the world for research on offshore oil
exploration.
The university has partnerships with several national and multinational
enterprises, some of which have facilities on the very UFRJ campi. It is the
case of Petrobras, whose biggest research center is located on Cidade
Universitária campus. Following a global trend, the UFRJ establishes and
maintains cooperative relationships with institutions from all continents,
which now amounts to over 200 international institutions all over the
world.

name: University of Campinas
description:
Originally named for its meadows, Campinas was founded in 1774 and lies
16 kilometers south of the University. With a population of about one
million people, Campinas is today an important and growing educational,
industrial and financial center.
The city has its own Symphony Orchestra – considered one of Brazil’s best –
cinemas, theatres, museums, parks, and fine shopping centers. Restaurants
serve a variety of regional and international dishes while pubs or
“barzinhos" are popular meeting places for stimulating conversations and
great music. Campinas is also the home of two popular soccer teams:
Guarani and Ponte Preta.
Recreation in the vicinity of Campinas is also rich and varied.
São Paulo, one of the world’s largest cities and an important cultural
center, is located 100 kilometers southeast of Campinas – a one-hour ride
by car or bus. In addition, many country resorts and parks are accessible,
offering a taste of life in the “interior" (countryside). Finally, the famous
São Paulo beaches of the coast are only a two-hour drive away.
Campinas is served by a good transportation network with bus service
being the most common form. The Viracopos International Airport is also
located within 30 minutes of Campinas.

name: University of Minas Gerais
description:
Universidade Federal de Minas Gerais, UFMG is a public university located
in the City of Belo Horizonte. UFMG offers a wide range of museums and
places of scientific and cultural interest, such as the Cultural Centre, the
UFMG Conservatory, the Natural History Museum, the Botanical Gardens
and the Museum of Morphological Science, all of which are open to the
public. In addition it organizes major arts events, such as the Winter and
Summer Festivals.

name: University of São Paulo
description: International Student and Researcher’s Guide

name: Concordia University
description:
Concordia University was founded in 1974 and supports a community of over 50,000 students
per year. The university has two campuses, set approximately 7 kilometres apart: Sir George
Williams Campus is the main campus in the downtown core of Montreal and Loyola Campus in
the residential district of Notre-Dame-de-Grâce. Concordia offers over 300 undergraduate and
100 graduate programs and courses

name: McGill University
description: McGill University was founded in 1821 and supports a community of over 35,000 students from about 150 countries. Campus is located in the city of Montreal, one of the world’s most student‐ friendly cities. Of Montreal’s 3.6 million residents, nearly 800,000 were born outside of Canada. A further 220,000 are students at universities or other professional post‐secondary programs.

name: McMaster University
description:
McMaster University was founded in 1887 and supports a community of 28,000 undergraduates
and 5,000 graduate students. The main campus is situated in Hamilton, only 45 minutes from
Toronto, Niagara Falls, and the U.S. border. McMaster also has four regional campuses:
downtown Hamilton, Burlington, Kitchener-Waterloo, and Niagara. The university offers over
250 cultural, academic and social issues clubs on campus.

name: Simon Fraser University
description:
Located on British Columbia's west coast Simon Fraser University opened in 1965 with 2,500
students. The university is now boasting more than 37,000 students and three campuses:
Burnaby Campus, Surrey Campus and Vancouver Campus. The Burnaby- and the Surrey Campus
are both approximately 40 min from downtown Vancouver, but can be easily reached with the
famous Expo Line.
SFU is the first Canadian member of the National Collegiate Athletic Association, the world’s
largest college sports association.

name: University of Alberta
description:
The University of Alberta Faculty of Law is Western Canada's most prestigious law school and one of Canada's leading institutions of legal education and research. For more than 100 years, the Faculty has been at the forefront of legal scholarship in Canada, fostering generations of thought leaders.
Approximately 525 Law students are enrolled in the law school (split over all 3 years of the law program).

name: University of British Columbia
description:
University of British Columbia was founded in 1908 and supports a community of almost 60,000
students whereof 12,000 are international students. UBC is a two-campus university: Okanagan
campus and Vancouver campus.
Vancouver Campus is located 30 minutes from the heart of downtown Vancouver in a
spectacular ‘must-see’ location. The Okanagan campus is nestled in the middle of the stunning
Okanagan Valley and is known for its small class sizes and first-name terms with the professors.

name: University of Calgary
description:
The University of Calgary was founded in 1966 and supports a community of over 26,000
students. Located in the foothills of Canada's snow-capped Rocky Mountains – about 15
minutes by train from downtown Calgary – the Uof C is situated on a beautifully landscaped
213-hectare campus area.
Exchange students have access to a wide range of world-class recreational facilities, including
Olympic training facilities, Fitness and Lifestyle Centre, Racquet Centre, Aquatic Centre and
Olympic Oval.

name: University of Guelph
description:
The University was founded in 1964 and supports a community of over 17,000 undergraduate
and 3000 graduate students. UofG Campus is located in the city of Guelph.
Guelph is situated in southwestern Ontario. Guelph is a vibrant community of 127,000 people
with a lively downtown, great shopping and a dynamic cultural scene. Surrounded by rolling
hills, Guelph is only a one hour drive or bus ride from Toronto. The city is very student-friendly,
with easy public transportation and a welcoming community feeling.

name: University of Toronto - Mississauga
description:
The University of Toronto was founded in 1827 and supports a community of over 90,000
graduate- and undergraduate students. UofT has three campuses: St. George (UTSG),
Mississauga (UTM) and Scarborough (UTSC).
The UTM campus is the second-largest division of UofT and is situated 33 kilometres west of
Toronto. It is easy to get from UTM to down town Toronto as there is a shuttle bus that students
can take free of charge between UTM and the city. The UTM campus boasts a vibrant research
environment and many of its faculty and researchers are recognized internationally for their
innovative work.

name: University of Toronto - Scarborough
description:
The University of Toronto was founded in 1827 and supports a community of over 90,000
graduate- and undergraduate students. UofT has three campuses: St. George (UTSG),
Mississauga (UTM) and Scarborough (UTSC).
The UTSC campus is situated in one of Toronto’s most diverse and multicultural neighborhoods
around 30 minutes from down town. UTSC has several new facilities and is especially known for
their International Development program.

name: University of Toronto - St. George
description:
The University of Toronto was founded in 1827 and supports a community of over 90,000
graduate- and undergraduate students. UofT has three campuses: St. George (UTSG),
Mississauga (UTM) and Scarborough (UTSC).
The UTSG campus is located in the city of Toronto at Queen’s Park. Within the Faculty of Arts &
Science on UTSG all students are affiliated with one of seven colleges. The colleges are a home
base for their students and provide the advantages of a closer-knit community experience
within a large research university.

name: University of Victoria
description:
The University was founded in 1963 and supports a community of over 22,000 students. UVic
Campus is located 20 minutes from downtown Victoria right by Cadboro Bay and the beautiful
neighborhood Ten Mile point. The University is committed to global leadership in
environmental, social and institutional sustainability.

name: Western University
description:
The university was founded in 1878 and is one of the oldest and most beautiful universities in
Canada. Located 200 km west of Toronto in London Western Campus has 40,000 students,
including more than 5,800 international students from 128 countries.
Known as the “Forest City" for its many parks and green areas, London has an extensive trail
system through the city along the Thames River, making it easy to travel to Toronto, Detroit and
many other destinations.

name: York University
description: At Osgoode, we encourage you to think differently. To reflect on what has value. To welcome diverse views. And once grounded in the fundamentals, to choose your own path, gaining practical experience as you find solutions to important legal challenges. Throughout our long history, we’ve always viewed the practice of law as far more than a means to an end. It’s a journey that takes you from deciding what matters to creating meaningful impact. And it starts here.

name: University of Chile
description:
Universidad de Chile is an urban institution, located in the city of Santiago,
capital of Chile and center of political, economic, social and cultural activity.
At the base of the Andes Mountains, at an altitude of 500 meters above sea
level and 120 kilometers from the Pacific Ocean, Santiago has a population
of more than 6 million inhabitants.
Universidad de Chile has campuses in different areas of the city, the most
important being: Campus Andrés Bello; Campus Juan Gómez Millas; Campus
Antumapu; Health Campus and Engineering Campus.

name: Chinese University of Hong Kong
description:
The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) is a leading comprehensive research university.
It has a total of 61 departments under the Faculties of Arts, Business Administration,
Education, Engineering, Law, Medicine, Science, and Social Science. Currently, it has
approximately 21,000 students undertaking undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral
programmes.
CUHK is the only university in Hong Kong with a college system. Each undergraduate student
is associated with one of the nine Colleges. The Colleges are responsible for informal
learning, and for academic and cultural immersion for students. CUHK is committed to
general education and whole-person development.

name: City University of Hong Kong
description:
Established as a University in 1994, CityU now has 3 Colleges and 4 Schools:
College of Business
College of Liberal Arts and Social Sciences
College of Science and Engineering
School of Creative Media
School of Energy and Environment
School of Law
School of Veterinary Medicine, jointly established as a partnership with Cornell University's
College of Veterinary Medicine and emblematic of CityU's commitment to One Health.
The curricula are designed to promote knowledge creation, original discoveries and
innovative thinking by integrating learning and research on all levels of the professional
education.
CityU has exchange links with more than 370 partners worldwide. Last year, they welcomed
more than 900 overseas students to CityU for exchange study.

name: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
University of Hong Kong
description:
The University of Hong Kong (HKU) is the oldest university in Hong Kong. As an Englishmedium university with a history that stretches back more than 100 years, it has grown with
and helped shape the city from which it takes its name.
Today, HKU is recognized internationally as a dynamic and comprehensive university of
world-class standing. With its distinguished excellence in research and outstanding
performance in teaching, it attracts first-class teaching and research staff and brilliant
students from around the world.
The University’s research students enjoy opportunities to work with leading international
researchers and a peer group of resourceful and committed students from different nations
in advanced facilities, producing cutting-edge and internationally recognized research work,
and developing skills essential for future careers and lifelong learning.
In 2003, during the outbreak of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS), HKU medical
researchers became the first in the world to identify the coronavirus that caused the SARS.

name: Fudan University
description:
Fudan consists of 29 schools and departments, with seventy undergraduate disciplines. The
University confers bachelor's degrees in seventy academic disciplines, and master's degrees
in two hundred and twenty five disciplines (with fifty of them established by the University
itself), and doctoral degrees in twenty-four Level I and one hundred and fifty-three Level II
academic disciplines (with twenty-nine of them established by the University itself). There
are also twenty-five research stations that offer postdoctoral fellowships.
Fudan now has an enrollment of 26,792 full-time degree candidates. Another 20,670 are
studying at the schools of Continuing Education and Online Education. Besides, the
University's population of foreign students is 2,812 today.

name: Peking University
description:
Peking University (PKU) is a student-oriented research university where individual
responsibility and independence are fundamental to the education offered. PKU strives to
create an environment where not only Chinese but also international students and staff feel
at home.
Since its establishment in 1898 as the first national comprehensive institution of higher
learning ever founded in China, PKU has been regarded as a symbol of modern Chinese
education. With democratic administration laying great emphasis on academic freedom and
scientific research, PKU has proudly produced a great number of scholars in various areas of
concentration and specialty. The student body, faculty, and alumni have made significant
research achievements and generated an incredible number of works of scholarship in both
the arts and the sciences.

name: Renmin University of China
description:
After its founding in 1950, Renmin Law School became the first institution of higher legal education in the People’s Republic of China and, as such, is dubbed as the "cradle" nurturing China’s most outstanding jurists.
At present, Renmin Law School educates more than 3,000 students annually with graduate students accounting for approximately 80% of the student body. The Law School confers undergraduate (LL.B.) and graduate degrees (LL.D. and LL.M.) in all secondary disciplines of law, including one national first-level key discipline and four national second-level key disciplines. Renmin Law School also offers a bachelor’s degree in Law with a concentration in Intellectual Property Rights. Authorized by the State Council of China, the Law School established the nation‘s first post-doctoral research center covering all doctoral subject areas.
Renmin Law School‘s 43 research institutes carry-out numerous projects of national and international importance.

name: Tsinghua University
description:
The campus of Tsinghua University is situated in northwest Beijing on the site of the former
imperial gardens of the Qing Dynasty, and surrounded by a number of historical sites.
Tsinghua University was established in 1911, originally under the name “Tsinghua Xuetang”.
Since China opened up to the world in 1978, Tsinghua University has developed at a
breathtaking pace into a comprehensive research university. At present, the university has
21 schools and 59 departments with faculties in science, engineering, humanities, law,
medicine, history, philosophy, economics, management, education and art.

name: University of Nottingham Ningbo China
description:
The University of Nottingham Ningbo, China is the first Sino-Foreign University in
China with approval from the Chinese Ministry of Education.
Located in the middle of China's coast (2.5 hours by bus from Shanghai), it is the cradle of the
cultures in Yangtze River Delta and also a portal city equipped with modern port facilities and
airport. Now it's playing an important role in economy, society, culture etc. as a major port
city along the south-eastern coast, a economic center in the southern wing of Yangtze Delta
and a famous state-level historic and cultural city. A lot of relics are well preserved here,
representing the toil and wisdom of the ancestors.
All study programmes are delivered entirely in English.

name: National Chengchi University
description:
National Chengchi University (NCCU) was founded in 1927, and for more than 9 decades of re-formation and development, we have been upholding our motto, “Harmony, Independence, Balance and Preeminence”, We continue to refine our teaching methods and research in order to nurture talents for our country and the world.
We currently have 12 colleges excelling in the Liberal Arts, Law, Commerce, Science, Foreign Languages, Social Sciences, Communication, International Affairs, Education, Innovation, Informatics, Global Banking and Finance. We have 34 departments, one undeclared major in the College of Communication, 43 master's programs and 34 doctoral programs. Additionally, NCCU offers 12 on-the-job Master’s Programs, and also 7 distinguished International Master's Programs and International Doctoral Program.
NCCU also has 10 university-level research center：the Institute of International Relations, Election Study Center, Center for the Third Sector, Center for Creativity and Innovation Studies, Taiwan Studies Center, Center for China Studies, Humanities Research Center, Center for Aboriginal Studies, Center for Mind, Brain and Learning and Center for the Study of Chinese Religions. In addition, NCCU forms an educational system from pre-school level to the Doctoral program with its affiliated institutions, including a high school, an experimental elementary school and a kindergarten.
Total Students: 16,000
International Degree-Seeking Students: 1,000+
International Exchange Students: 780+
Chinese Learning Center Students: 900+
Total Faculty Members: 1,400+ (Full time and Part time)

name: National Taiwan University
description:
Characterized by both tradition and innovation, National Taiwan Normal University (NTNU) has
long been recognized as one of Taiwan’s elite institutions of higher education. Founded in 1922,
NTNU was formerly an institution dedicated to teacher education. The university later evolved
into a comprehensive university that provides students and scholars with opportunities to study
and conduct research in a wide range of fields. Throughout its long history, NTNU has always
been committed to academic excellence and this is reflected in the many influential educators
and researchers that have studied at NTNU over the years.

name: Tunghai University
description:
In 1955, thanks to the whole-hearted efforts of Taiwanese educators and Christians, Tunghai University was established in Taichung City , a great place for a university thanks to its geographic beauty and convenience. To serve the foreign staff of the university, the Chinese Language Centre was established in 1970, the first such centre in central Taiwan . The CLC is nestled within beautiful trees, flowers, and bird songs, making it an excellent place for learning Chinese.
Through Tunghai international education has steadily promoted and Chinese education become common gradually, more and more international students and expatriates choose Tunghai University to have culture and academic exchange. The Chinese Language Centre in Tunghai provides courses of Chinese learning not only to international students, but also expatriates. To face the variety of instruction patterns in recent society­- “No limitation in classes, no boundary on learning.”

name: University of the Andes
description: Universidad de los Andes, commonly known as Uniandes, was founded in 1948 as a private and independent university. Uniandes is located near the historical center of Colombia’s capital city Bogotá. Uniandes has around 17.000 students.

name: University of Zagreb
description:
The University of Zagreb is the oldest Croatian university and the oldest university
in South East Europe. The university was officially founded 23 September 1669 by
Emperor and King Leopold I Habsburg

name: University of Cyprus
description: The University of Cyprus is a public research university established in Nicosia, Cyprus in 1989. It admitted its first students in 1992 and has approximately 7000 students. The teaching language is Greek and English.

name: Charles University (Prague)
description:
Established in 1348, Charles University stands as one of the oldest and most esteemed universities in the world. Despite its rich historical legacy, the university maintains a forward-thinking and cosmopolitan approach, making it a modern and prestigious institution of higher education. As the largest and top-rated university in the Czech Republic, Charles University boasts 17 faculties, with 14 of them located in the vibrant city of Prague. The university's commitment to internationalization is evident in its diverse student body, with over 9,000 international students comprising approximately 20% of the total student population. This multicultural environment fosters a lively and dynamic atmosphere within the university.
Offering a wide range of courses in multiple languages, including English, German, French, and Czech, Charles University ensures that students from various backgrounds can pursue their academic goals. As an Erasmus student, one can benefit from the support of international associations dedicated to facilitating the integration and orientation process. Additionally, each faculty hosts various clubs and organizations, such as film clubs, choirs, and book clubs, providing students with opportunities to engage in extracurricular activities and explore their diverse interests. Charles University serves as a thriving hub of intellectual growth, cultural exchange, and community engagement, making it a highly sought-after institution for students seeking a comprehensive and enriching educational experience.
Prague offers a rich and stimulating environment for student life, combining historical depth with modern infrastructure. The city is compact and well-connected by public transport, including a metro system known for its depth and efficiency. Students can explore medieval streets, vibrant cultural venues, and green spaces throughout the city. A fun fact: Prague is home to the world’s largest castle complex (the Prague Castle) which spans over 70,000 square meters and includes palaces, churches, and historic lanes, making it a central part of the city’s identity and a frequent destination for students and visitors alike.

name: Czech University of Life Sciences Prague
description:
The Czech University of Life Sciences Prague (CZU) is a leading modern scientific and pedagogical workplace well-known in Europe and throughout the world. It is one of the prestigious Czech universities, which at present, about 20,000 students study at the university every year.
The CZU study programmes and fields offer education in a wide spectrum of areas. Fields covering agricultural practice and fields relating thereto are taught at the university in the entire agricultural-food vertical. The university also offers fields focused on the development of rural areas and regions, or fields relating to leisure time activities (e.g. horse breeding and dog breeding).

name: Norwegian School of Sport Sciences
description:
Established in 1870, the Norwegian School of Sport Sciences (NIH) is a public university located in Oslo, Norway.
The NIH faculty has a broad international network of research collaborators as well as more than 1600 students. NIH offers a unique learning opportunity for exchange students through a beautifully scenic campus, world-class facilities, rich campus culture, a variety of English-led classes, and diverse student activity groups all of which are available to exchange students.

name: American University in Cairo
description: Located in Cairo, in the heart of the Middle East, AUC is a leading English-language, American-accredited institution of higher education and center of intellectual, social and cultural life of the Arab world.

name: University of Tartu
description:
Estonia, in North-Eastern Europe, is home to the Johan Skytte Institute of Political Studies at the
University of Tartu. The institute itself is located in the heart of Estonia's second largest town,
Tartu, which is home to around one hundred thousand people. The town's long university
traditions and academically oriented environment laid the foundation for the strong principles
of the Skytte Institute. Our focus areas are English
linguistics and CLIL (Content language integrate learning method), youth work, Teaching Russian
as a foreign language and IT.

name: University of the Faroe Islands
description:
The University of the Faroe Islands is a small but respected institution with about 1000 students. The university offers programs and courses mainly in Faroese and Danish, with some courses available in English. Its size and focus on regional issues provide a distinctive opportunity to study topics related to sustainability, marine resources, and the arctic region.
The university is located in Tórshavn, the capital of the Faroe Islands, a small and charming city that combines traditional Nordic character with modern conveniences. The city is compact and quite hilly and offers a warm and friendly atmosphere. Surrounded by stunning cliffs, green valleys, and the open sea, the city provides easy access to hiking trails and breathtaking nature, making it a perfect setting for students who enjoy the outdoors.

name: Åbo Akademi University
description:
Åbo Akademi University is Finland’s only Swedish-language multidisciplinary university, founded in 1918, with its main activities in two campuses: Åbo (Turku) and Vasa. It has around 7,000 students, including about 1,000 international students each year. The official language of instruction is Swedish, but there is a wide array of courses taught in English (around 250 annually) for exchange students.
Turku (Åbo in Swedish) is Finland’s oldest city and a charming place to live and study. With over 40,000 students in the city and a historic, cultural atmosphere, there's always something going on — theatre, museums or festivals. Turku lies on the southwest coast of Finland, close to the archipelago, has good transport links to other parts of Finland and beyond, and provides a picturesque natural environment (coastline, islands, parks) for both study and recreation.

name: Haaga-Helia University of Applied Sciences
description:
Haaga-Helia currently enrolls more than 11,000 students and 650 academic staff, and hosts almost 400 exchange students every year. Haaga-Helia consists of 5 campuses: Haaga, Malmi, Pasila, Porvoo, and Vierumäki.
Sports Studies at Haaga-Helia are situated at the Vierumäki campus. Vierumäki campus is located at Vierumäki Resort, about an hour’s drive from Helsinki. The Vierumäki Resort is Finland’s most diverse center for recreational activities, providing opportunities for countless sports and forms of exercise.

name: Tampere University
description: Tampere University, established in 2019 through the merger of the University of Tampere and Tampere University of Technology, is a culturally committed higher education institution with a mission to educate visionary individuals who understand and shape the world. Boasting six faculties and an annual student intake of around 20,000, Tampere University stands among the largest and most popular universities in Finland with teaching being exclusively in English. The University of Tampere has two campuses in Tampere: a central campus near the city's railway station and the Kauppi campus, situated alongside the Tampere University Hospital. Join the vibrant community of Tampere University and embark on a transformative educational journey.

name: University of Eastern Finland
description: The University of Eastern Finland, established in 2010 through the merger of the University of Joensuu and the University of Kuopio, is a prestigious institution with campuses in Joensuu and Kuopio. The UEF Law School offers diverse study opportunities and encourages multidisciplinary research collaboration. Specializing in areas such as Environmental Law, Climate Change Law, Energy Law, Empirical Juridical Research, and Welfare Law, the UEF Law School emphasizes international cooperation and networking. Choose from a range of Bachelor's and Master's courses at the University of Eastern Finland's Law School and embark on a rewarding academic journey in law.

name: University of Helsinki
description:
The University of Helsinki is Finland’s largest and oldest university, with about 31,000 students across four campuses. It offers a wide range of English-taught courses and programmes, making it a welcoming choice for exchange students. While Finnish and Swedish are the official languages, English is widely used in both academic and social settings, ensuring that international students can easily participate in studies and campus life.
Helsinki itself is a safe, student-friendly city surrounded by nature and the sea. Its compact size makes it easy to get around, and students can enjoy both lively urban culture and peaceful outdoor areas within minutes. From waterfront cafés and island trips to forests and parks near the campuses,

name: University of Jyväskylä
description: The University of Jyväskylä is a dynamic and esteemed multidisciplinary institution in Finland. With six faculties and independent institutes, it stands as one of the largest and most popular universities in the country. Founded in 1863 as the first Finnish-speaking teacher training college, Jyväskylä Teacher Seminary, it has evolved into a nationally and internationally recognized research university. Known for its expertise in education, human sciences, and natural sciences, the University of Jyväskylä attracts top-tier students and is highly selective. Embrace a transformative academic journey at this prestigious institution, ranked as the second largest university in Finland.

name: University of Lapland
description:
Discover the University of Lapland, a renowned international and multidisciplinary university located in Rovaniemi, on the Arctic Circle. With expertise in art and design, education, law, social sciences, and Northern and Arctic issues, as well as tourism research, this university offers a diverse range of academic disciplines.
For the Faculty of Law, the University of Lapland is a key player in legal education, responsible for educating a significant portion of Finland's lawyers. Their innovative degree structure combines various modes of study, fostering a balance between practical skills and theoretical knowledge. Within the faculty, three prominent institutes specialize in Air and Space Law, Commercial Law, and Law and Informatics. Additionally, the faculty provides a comprehensive selection of English-taught courses, ensuring accessibility for international students.

name: University of Oulu
description:
The University of Oulu welcomes over 600 exchange students from all over
the world every year.

name: University of Turku
description:
Welcome to the University of Turku, Finland's third-largest university in terms of student enrollment. With eight faculties and a shared campus with Åbo Akademi University, the University of Turku offers a diverse and vibrant academic environment. Collaboratively, these two universities provide a wide range of high-quality academic courses taught in English.
Turku Law School, renowned for its commitment to excellence, conducts cutting-edge education and research across a wide academic spectrum. The faculty's dedicated teachers and researchers actively engage in public discourse, contributing their expertise to important discussions. As a cooperative organization involving two universities in Turku, Turku Law School benefits from a rich academic network and collaborative opportunities.

name: University of Vaasa
description: Discover the essence of business-focused education and international collaboration at the University of Vaasa. As a multidisciplinary university, it prioritizes key areas such as management and change, energy and sustainable development, and finance and economic decision-making. With a modest student population of approximately 5,000, the University of Vaasa offers a close-knit and personalized learning experience. Located in the picturesque neighborhood of Palosaari, alongside the city's historic cotton mill, part of the university's campus is nestled within the charming premises. Situated near the waterfront and surrounded by serene park areas, the campus proudly holds the distinction of being known as the most beautiful campus in Finland. Immerse yourself in this inspiring environment and embrace the opportunities that await at the University of Vaasa.

name: Aix-Marseille University
description:
Aix-Marseille Université (AMU) is France's largest French-speaking multidisciplinary university, formed from a 2012 merger of three universities, offering a wide range of studies across its 19 faculties and 12 doctoral schools on five major campuses in southern France.
With around 80,000 students, including 12,000 international students, AMU is known for its strong research focus, extensive partnerships, and high-quality welcome for international students, holding a prestigious "Welcome to France" label.

name: CY Cergy Paris University
description:
Cergy Paris University is a public Institution and a leading centre of teaching and research. The University is composed of 5 departments: Law, Economy and Management, Languages, Literature and Social Sciences, Science and Technology. The University takes also part in the European exchange program and has adopted the ECTS system (European Credit Transfer System) which allows European students to obtain credits in their university for courses taken abroad. Cergy-Pontoise has been pointed out as a “Model University” several times by the French government.
Cergy Paris is situated in the department of the Val-d’Oise in the Paris region. It is a dynamic city which offers a broad spectrum of artistic and cultural events thanks to its numerous theatres, museums and concert halls.
From Paris it takes approx. 40 minutes by train to reach the town Cergy-Pontoise.

name: École des Hautes Études en Sciences Sociales
description:
École des Hautes Études en Sciences Sociales (EHESS) is a distinguished graduate-only research institution, founded in 1984 as a
grand établissement
alongside the Collège de France and Sciences Po. With its main campus in Paris and additional sites in Marseille, Lyon, and Toulouse, EHESS is internationally recognized for its interdisciplinary approach to the social sciences and humanities. The university has been home to some of the most influential thinkers of the 20th century, including Pierre Bourdieu, Claude Lévi-Strauss, and Jacques Derrida. Today, EHESS hosts a diverse student body of approximately 3,000 students from around the world, drawn by its unique academic environment that combines rigorous historical analysis with contemporary research.
Situated in central Paris, EHESS offers students an exceptional opportunity to study in one of Europe’s foremost intellectual and cultural capitals. The university’s location places students at the heart of a city renowned for its libraries, archives, museums, and vibrant academic life. Paris provides a stimulating backdrop for scholarly engagement, with countless opportunities to attend public lectures, exhibitions, and cultural events. For students seeking a rich academic experience alongside immersion in a dynamic urban setting, EHESS represents an ideal destination for an exchange semester.

name: École Normale Supérieure de Lyon
description:
The École Normale Supérieure de Lyon (ENS de Lyon) is a highly selective French public institution focused on advanced education and research in the sciences and humanities. It hosts approximately 2,300 students and over 500 faculty and researchers. ENS de Lyon is part of the network of Écoles normales supérieures, known for preparing students for careers in academia and public service. The institution is distinguished by its strong emphasis on research-led teaching and its integration with national research bodies such as CNRS and INRIA. Its compact size and rigorous academic environment foster close interaction between students and researchers, offering a setting that differs from larger, more generalist universities.
ENS de Lyon is located in the city of Lyon, France’s third-largest urban area and a major centre for education, culture, and innovation. The university’s campuses are situated in the Gerland district, which is well connected by public transport and close to both the Rhône river and the city’s central areas. Lyon combines historical architecture with modern infrastructure and is known for its role in the humanities, sciences, and gastronomy. The city offers a manageable scale, active student life, and access to cultural institutions, making it a practical and engaging place to spend an exchange semester. Its location in southeastern France also provides convenient links to other European cities and regions.

name: Institut d'Etudes Politique de Lyon (Sciences Po)
description:
Founded in 1948, Sciences Po Lyon is a public higher education institute specializing in Human and Social Sciences and training future executives in the public and private sectors. The educational model is similar to that of Anglo-Saxon Schools of Public Affairs or School of Government. Their teaching is fueled by a constant quest for excellence and cultivates a multi-disciplinary approach in human and social sciences based on four fundamental disciplines: history, law, political science, and economy.
Since 2017, Sciences Po Lyon has operated two campuses: the historical campus in Lyon city centre and a second in Saint-Étienne. International students who visit us for a semester or a full academic year will study on the Lyon campus.
With its 1,800 students, Sciences Po Lyon is a higher education institute of a size that enables it to retain a human touch, offering optimal study conditions that can benefit each and every individual student.

name: Institut d'études politiques de Bordeaux (Sciences Po)
Institut d'études politiques de Paris (Sciences Po)
description: Sciences Po is an international research university, both selective and open onto the world, ranking among the finest institutions in the fields of humanities and social sciences. Sciences Po has become an international research university with 14,000 students. Sciences Po stands out for combining approaches and confronting different worldviews. This tradition of diversity and multidisciplinary approach makes Sciences Po an active participant in public debate, a forum where thought meets action. Sciences Po's overarching mission is to educate future leaders in the public and private sectors.

name: Institut d'Etudes Politiques de Toulouse (Sciences Po)
description:
Institut d'Études Politiques de Toulouse, commonly known as Sciences Po Toulouse, is a selective and prestigious institution specializing in political science, international relations, law, economics, and sociology. Founded in 1948, it is part of the network of Sciences Po institutes across France and is recognized for its rigorous academic programs and strong emphasis on interdisciplinary research. Sciences Po Toulouse offers a dynamic learning environment with a student body of around 1,500, including a growing number of international students. The institution is particularly committed to preparing students for careers in public service, international organizations, and policy-making, while also fostering critical thinking and civic engagement.
Located in the vibrant city of Toulouse, Sciences Po offers students a unique blend of academic excellence and quality of life. Toulouse is the fourth-largest city in France and a major center for aerospace, innovation, and higher education. Known for its rich history, lively cultural scene, and welcoming atmosphere, the city provides an ideal setting for student life. With its mix of historic architecture, green spaces, and bustling cafés, Toulouse offers both inspiration and comfort. Exchange students at Sciences Po Toulouse benefit not only from a stimulating academic experience but also from the opportunity to explore a dynamic and youthful city in the heart of southern France.

name: L'École nationale supérieure de paysage
description: Ecole Nationale Supérieure du Paysage (ENSP) prepares future landscape architects to be involved in the design of parks, gardens, regions, rural areas, and urban public spaces. With two locations, one at Versailles and the other at Marseilles, the ENSP offers several advanced study programs, which centre upon the development of the landscape studio project.

name: Oniris, Ecole Nationale Vétérinaire, Agroalimentaire et de l'alimentation de Nantes-Atlantique
Sorbonne Nouvelle University
description:
Sorbonne Nouvelle University (Université Sorbonne Nouvelle – Paris 3) is a public institution within the Sorbonne group, specialising in the humanities and social sciences. It hosts approximately 18,000 students and employs over 1,300 academic and administrative staff. The university is known for its strong international orientation and its commitment to interdisciplinary research. As part of the European University Alliance UNA Europa, Sorbonne Nouvelle contributes to collaborative academic initiatives across the continent. Its structure supports close engagement between students and faculty, and its programmes are designed to foster analytical thinking and academic independence.
The university is located in Paris, with its main campus situated in the 12th arrondissement near Place de la Nation. This area offers good transport connections and access to a range of cultural and everyday amenities. Paris itself is home to numerous academic institutions, libraries, and research centres, making it a central location for higher education in Europe. The city’s historical significance, public infrastructure, and international character provide a stimulating environment for students. An exchange semester at Sorbonne Nouvelle offers the opportunity to study in a major European capital while engaging with a diverse academic and social landscape.

name: Sorbonne University
description:
Sorbonne University, a prestigious and globally renowned academic institution, stands as a multidisciplinary and research-driven university. Firmly rooted in the heart of Paris, its historical roots trace back to 1257, making it one of the oldest universities in Europe. With its three faculties encompassing Arts & Humanities, Medicine, and Science and Engineering, the university is dedicated to nurturing student excellence and addressing the scientific complexities of the modern era. Serving as a beacon of higher education and research, Sorbonne University holds a distinguished position within the French academic landscape.
Furthermore, Sorbonne is a part of 4EU+ Alliance with the purpose of laying the foundation for an innovative European university model. Sorbonne is fully committed to engage with both its students and partners on an international scale. The university believes that internalization and innovation go hand in hand. In terms of student life, Sorbonne offers more than 80 sporting and artistic activities which are free to join as students off the university.

name: Toulouse Capitole University
description:
Université Toulouse Capitole is a prominent French public university specializing in law, economics, management, and political science. With roots dating back to the 13th century, the university has evolved into a modern institution known for its academic rigor and international outlook. It hosts several renowned research centers and offers a wide range of graduate and postgraduate programs, many of which are taught in English. The university attracts a diverse student body, including a growing number of international students, and maintains strong partnerships with institutions across Europe and beyond. Its commitment to interdisciplinary research and professional development makes it an excellent choice for students seeking both academic depth and career-oriented training.
Located in the heart of Toulouse, Université Toulouse Capitole offers students the chance to study in one of France’s most dynamic and student-friendly cities. Toulouse is known for its vibrant cultural life, historical charm, and strong presence in the aerospace and technology sectors. The city combines a rich architectural heritage with a youthful energy, making it an ideal environment for both academic focus and social engagement. Students can enjoy a wide range of cultural events, outdoor activities, and a welcoming atmosphere that supports both learning and personal growth. An exchange semester at Toulouse Capitole promises not only academic enrichment but also a memorable experience in one of southern France’s most attractive urban settings.

name: Université Côte d'Azur
description:
Université Côte d’Azur is a public research university located in the Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur region of southern France. It brings together over 18,000 students and more than 2,000 academic and administrative staff across multiple campuses and research centres. The university is part of the European University Alliance Ulysseus and has been recognized as an Initiative of Excellence (IDEX) by the French government, highlighting its commitment to high-level research and innovation. Its structure integrates several academic institutions and research bodies, fostering collaboration across disciplines and supporting a strong international orientation.
The university is based in Nice and the surrounding area, offering students access to both urban and coastal environments. Nice is a mid-sized city on the Mediterranean coast, known for its cultural heritage, public transport infrastructure, and proximity to Italy and Monaco. The region combines academic resources with a high quality of life, including access to museums, libraries, and outdoor activities. For students seeking a well-connected and diverse setting for their exchange semester, Université Côte d’Azur offers a practical and engaging environment in one of France’s most internationally oriented regions.

name: Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne
description:
Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne is one of France’s leading public universities, with a strong academic tradition rooted in the historic Sorbonne. It serves over 40,000 students and employs more than 1,400 academic and administrative staff. The university is known for its focus on humanities, social sciences, law, and economics, and maintains active research centres across these fields. It plays a central role in French academic life and contributes to international research networks. Its structure supports a broad academic offering while maintaining close links to national institutions and cultural organisations, making it a distinctive institution within the French higher education system.
The university is located in central Paris, with sites spread across several historic buildings in the Latin Quarter and other parts of the city. This location places students in direct contact with the intellectual and cultural life of the capital, with access to libraries, archives, museums, and public institutions. Paris offers a wide range of academic and cultural resources, as well as efficient transport connections to other regions and countries. For students considering an exchange semester, Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne provides an opportunity to study in a city closely tied to European academic and cultural history.

name: Université Paris 2 Panthéon-Assas
description:
Considered as France's first Law University, Université Paris II Panthéon-Assas is dedicated to upholding the tradition from which it arose, preserving, yet ever-striving to raise its level of excellence in the following fields of study and research: Private Law and Criminal Science, Public Law, Political Science, Roman Law, History of Law, Economics, Management, Information and Communication Sciences.
Attentive to students' needs, the university provides various numerical services, tutorials, an ever-growing and comprehensive library database, course and professional counselling services, and a selection of extracurricular athletic and cultural activities all acting in concert to complete and harmonize each student's university experience.
